readsAs: a candle or bottle with a detached, oddly shaped flame
a perfume or sauce bottle with a hooked drip above it
a thumbs-up hand shape under a floating blob
judge.why: The two parts don't hold together as one mark: the flame floats too far from the body, it is lopsided, and the uneven shoulders on the body look accidental, so it reads as a clumsy candle or bottle rather than a heavy eyelid or wind-down, and at small home-screen sizes it breaks into two unrelated specks.
